root_cause: Sample email/upload source and local Datahub safe test can return successful stage evidence and a test execution id, while the original activation evaluator checked only passed stages and same-version id, not whether external source and target providers were actually queried. Portal had no explicit per-connector downstream use selection.
fix: Introduce server-derived proofLevel gate and default-deny tenant connector data-use mode; separate sample test from external provider-verified activation; integrate customer-selected portal/AI use and existing sovereignty policy with readable UI.
prevention_rules: Never promote an example, static readiness declaration or local target dry-run into externally verified activation or a healthy production status.
Connected data usage requires tenant-specific, per-connector permission; default CONNECTION_ONLY, deny training and ungoverned AI model routes.
Always disclose actual storage/processing/model regions from provider receipts, never infer from the Supabase primary region or a requested deployment profile.
Provider authentication and actual source-to-destination execution require independent signed-off evidence and current protected release readback.
Remain within the original Portal V2, connector, data sovereignty, ONE BRAIN, Heartbeat and protected release owners; no parallel executor or direct production change.
Learning canonicalization requires a real tests/brain-*.test.mjs evaluation entry point; import and execute the full original connector suites rather than weakening the CI gate.
owner: original Portal V2 UX + connector engine + ONE BRAIN/Heartbeat + protected release writer
